title: Feed Him MEOW — Ingredient Garden
notes: Ingredient Garden ingredient tokens are SVG-only. Runtime rejects non-SVG ingredient aliases.
Garden required objectives exclude catalog entries with gardenCollectable=false; kitchen-only recipe components remain in the recipe.
Garden objectives and filler candidates obey the active recipe difficulty authority; Super Easy/Easy cannot spawn fish.
Randomizer seeds non-rectangular topologies, ecology hazards, pre-seeded specials, and named level programs while preserving replay determinism.
Vines creep, mud oozes, quicksand periodically sinks filler ingredients, mobile bees relocate among neighboring cells, flowers shed layered petals, and thorns remain multi-hit locks.
Honey is a layered pinned overlay: the trapped ingredient cannot move, but it remains matchable so a match formed from outside the honey cracks the shell until the ingredient is freed.
Onyx physically moves his bubble to booster targets before Garden boosters resolve; booster-specific static moods and coded impact effects are selected by booster type.
Sunbeam shrivels vines/infection and dries wet hazards; Weed Spray damages a selected ecology patch; Bee Smoker scatters bees and cracks honey.
Every hazard spread/movement operation preserves a legal-play invariant or rolls back/shuffles rather than intentionally leaving the board unwinnable.
WASD/arrow navigation, touch/mouse trace and swap input, reduced motion, relay garden effects, and the idle Onyx snack behavior remain supported.
Level Select can launch a full three-mini-game run, Pinball Fishing only, or Ingredient Garden only from the same Solo/Duo dialog.
Overall level progression is 0-5 stars: 1 star unlocks the next level, while 5 stars is reserved for completing all three mini-games in a full run with 3-star Garden performance.
All primary game windows and menus use the shared eight-direction UI resizer; stretching a surface scales its controls, labels, and buttons with it.
Pass 22 keeps the Pass 21 +35% Garden objective volume and adds another +12% recipe ingredient requirement volume.

Every cleared recipe-ingredient tile now contributes only a fraction of one Garden ingredient unit: about 92% at Level 1, 89% at Level 10, 86% at Level 25, 82% at Level 50, 75% at Level 90, and never below 68% from Level 140 onward.
The old 15-turn Match-3 / 45-turn trace completion gates are removed. A level ends as soon as its ingredient objectives are actually complete.

Move and time budgets are calculated from the real remaining ingredient units, fractional yield, interaction-mode collection efficiency, difficulty safety margin, and ingredient diversity so difficulty comes from recipe work rather than filler turns.

difficultyAuthority.nonCollectableRecipeItems: remain Kitchen recipe components but never become Garden objectives or filler

starProgression.fiveStarRequirement: Complete Pinball Fishing, Ingredient Garden, and Kitchen in one full-level run; Garden performance must earn 3/3 internal stars.
starProgression.fourStarRequirement: Complete all three mini-games in one full-level run; Garden performance must earn at least 2/3 internal stars.

gardenPacing.limitRule: dynamic objective-derived move/time budget; no fixed 15/45 minimum-turn gate
